title: Lying Y raise

steps.text: Lie face down with your forehead on the floor or on a folded towel.
Reach your arms forward and a little out, like the letter Y, with your thumbs up.
steps.cue: Arms in a Y, thumbs up.

steps.text: Draw your shoulder blades down and lift both arms a little off the floor.
steps.cue: Shoulder blades down. Lift your arms a little.

steps.text: Hold for a breath, then lower slowly. Keep your neck long and your feet on the floor.

mistakes: Lifting the head and straining the neck.
Swinging the arms up instead of lifting slowly.
regression: Lift one arm at a time, or bend your elbows.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your shoulders, neck or lower back.

anatomy.why: The upper back lifts the arms by drawing the shoulder blades back and down.
